name: Santa Ana
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Santa Ana, CA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Santa Ana, California for 2026: Gingerbread Wonderland at Discovery Cube, Bowers Museum festival and more, dates checked on host sites.
lede: Santa Ana kicks off Christmas with a free downtown tree lighting at Plaza Navideña, then fills December with museum festivals, a gingerbread display and church and community winter villages.
celebrates: Santa Ana's season opens with Plaza Navideña, the City of Santa Ana's free community tree lighting at Plaza Calle Cuatro in downtown, with local vendors, arts and crafts, live entertainment and photos with Santa. The museums carry the rest of the season. Bowers Museum holds a free International Winter Holidays Family Festival in its Key Courtyard, Discovery Cube Orange County runs Gingerbread Wonderland and the Science of Gingerbread display, and the Heritage Museum of Orange County decorates the 1898 Kellogg House for the holidays. Newsong Church adds a snowy Winter Village the Saturday after Thanksgiving.
lastyear: In 2025 the City of Santa Ana held Plaza Navideña on Saturday, November 22, from 5 to 8 pm at Plaza Calle Cuatro, according to the Santa Ana Zoo's post about the city parks event, which listed a Christmas tree lighting ceremony and photos with Santa. For 2026 the city's event page moved the tree lighting to Saturday, November 21, from 5 to 8 pm at the same plaza, 325 E 4th St, so it has already happened by the time most 2026 events begin.
facts: Plaza Navideña is a downtown Santa Ana tradition run by the City of Santa Ana, and the city's event page says it supports local businesses as it lights a tree right in the heart of downtown. The city also ran a Santa Ana Winter Village with ice skating and a holiday light show, but the city's page now says that event is permanently closed. Bowers Museum, on North Main Street, was opened in 1936, according to its Eventbrite organizer page, making it one of the oldest museums in Orange County.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Santa Ana itself. Santa Ana has a rail station, and the Fullerton Train Museum, with seven vintage railcars and a Metrolink locomotive beside the Fullerton Transportation Center, is free and open on the first and third Saturdays of each month from 9 am to noon, according to our museum page. The Irvine Park Railroad in nearby Orange runs Christmas trains and Santa's Village, according to its own site, and Anaheim's Disneyland Railroad is covered in our Anaheim guide.

kidfact: Santa Ana is home to the Discovery Cube, where a gingerbread village has a real indoor toboggan slide.
faq: What is the best free Christmas event for kids in Santa Ana?

Bowers Museum's International Winter Holidays Family Festival on December 6, 2026 is free, with live performances, face painting, art making and treats. The city's Plaza Navideña tree lighting was on November 21, 2026.
Is there a Christmas tree lighting in Santa Ana?
Yes. The City of Santa Ana lights its downtown tree at Plaza Navideña at Plaza Calle Cuatro, 325 E 4th St. In 2026 it was on November 21 from 5 to 8 pm, with photos with Santa and live entertainment.
Can kids visit Santa in Santa Ana?
Santa's Cottage at Discovery Cube Orange County has visits on December 6-7, 13-14 and 20-24 from 11 am to 3 pm, according to the museum.
Is there ice skating at the Santa Ana Winter Village?
No. The City of Santa Ana's Winter Village page says the event is permanently closed.
Where are the Santa Ana Christmas events held?
Most are in the Main Street museum area, with Bowers Museum and Discovery Cube on North Main Street, and the Heritage Museum of Orange County on West Harvard Street.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Santa Ana for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Winter Village at Newsong Church) through January 3, 2027 (Gingerbread Wonderland at Discovery Cube Orange County), with the International Winter Holidays Family Festival at Bowers Museum (December 6) and Christmas on Main Street at the Heritage Museum of Orange County (December 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
